PRE-TREATMENT IS KEY TO SUCCESS

Protect the Membranes

Screens remove shells, creatures, wood and debris greater than % inch

Heavier solids settled out via flocculation and clarification

Smaller solids filtered via microfiltration membranes

Ultraviolet light controls biological activity and fouling

Control scale formation by adjusting pH and using antiscalants
